scope: All successful encodings, regardless of reconstruction identity

definitions.json_bytes: Compact JSON encoding of IDs and external edges, excluding model storage and metadata; not an optimal binary format.
definitions.safe_blocks: Dot-separated SAFE blocks, including disconnected components. Reported only where the original audit recorded this metric; denominator is explicit.
definitions.length_scope: No identity-based filtering; invalid inputs and failed encodings have no token sequence.
